CHAT_TOKEN.description: Browser/user token. Same value as on the AWS node.

PI_TOKEN.description: Token for the pi worker. Same value as on the AWS node.

CLAUDE_TOKEN.description: Token for the claude worker. Same value as on the AWS node.

UPSTREAM_URL.description: HTTPS origin of the AWS room-owner node, e.g. https://1-2-3-4.sslip.io (no path, no credentials).
